snippet.title: Super Mario Bros. 6 (2025) - Hack of Tiny Toon Adventures [NES]
snippet.description:
Hack Released By Kensuyjin33 @KensuWilliam 
https://www.romhacking.net/hacks/8886/
v1.0 Release date: February 24, 2025

Secret Boss: https://youtu.be/VJIO3Jq7o1I

"If you had an innocent childhood, you likely spent time playing those unlicensed plumber games, often mistaking them for official sequels. One such game, titled *Super Bros 6* , was actually *Tiny Toon Adventures* . This hack makes several aesthetic modifications, including:

- Replacing all enemies with characters from the Super Mario universe
- Swapping the bosses to Mario-themed characters (including the secret boss)
- Adjusting level designs in multiple stages to optimize resource usage
- Overhauling certain levels to better fit the game's theme
- Adding new cinematics that tell a completely original story, along with other minor changes"
